technology.hero_subtitle: Vacuum evaporation reimagined with engineering plastic
technology.how_it_works_text: Vacuum evaporation reduces the boiling point of liquids by lowering the pressure. This allows waste water to be evaporated at low temperatures, concentrating pollutants while recovering clean distillate. The result: up to 95% volume reduction of your waste stream.

how_it_works_steps.step2_desc: Under vacuum, water evaporates at low temperature
how_it_works_steps.step3_desc: Clean water vapor is condensed and collected
how_it_works_steps.step4_desc: Concentrated residue is removed for disposal

technology.why_plastic_text: Traditional vacuum evaporators are built from stainless steel or exotic alloys. While these work for mild waste streams, they corrode and fail when processing aggressive chemicals. EVAplate solves this by building the entire evaporator from engineering plastic.

comparison.evaplate_maintenance: Minimal — no corrosion means less wear

benefits.chemical_desc: Processes acids, alkalis, solvents, and mixed waste that would destroy metal systems.

benefits.lifespan_desc: Engineering plastic maintains structural integrity far longer than metal in harsh environments.
benefits.application_desc: Handle waste streams that were previously impossible or uneconomical to process.
